Audit passed: OK to merge and deploy Exact-head audit (Claudio) of PR #293 at head 990a4cb535fd3ccb2a81ca019f453123b60a14b8, base main f830f900f597f20e12570b583e4e32ce9cb50a1d. Refs #213. **Checks on this exact head:** - **CI "Test & Build":** run 38197850846 passed at 03:21:35Z, covering the server suite, client build, both Docker builds, the boundary rehearsal and readiness. - **Local server `npm test`:** 345 of 345 suites pass. - My first full run reached 146 passing suites. A second Jest process I started in the same worktree then deleted the shared test template during its teardown, so every later suite failed with "unable to open database file". That was my setup error, not the code, and the log is kept. - The 199 suites that did not pass in that run were rerun alone and all pass, 1888 of 1888 tests. The browser keyboard suite also passes fresh. - **Client `npm run build`:** passes. **`npm run lint`:** 0 errors and 14 warnings, the same count as main. - **Independent review:** Pip found no code findings, and their 104 tests and 8 additional scenarios pass (6117043896). **Against #213:** - **Every export equals the report [test]:** `server/tests/contracts/issue_213_export_equals_report.test.js` has five cases: - an ATTEMPT selection from a batched source; - a MEAN of a questioned 12.0 and its repeat 12.6, exported as 12.3; - a reviewer-selected QUESTIONED source; - NOT_REPORTABLE with localized text; - SOC configured in %, which keeps its unconverted headline. In each case, SIS v1, the adapter, the v1 matrix, GeoJSON, WET_CHEM, SPECTRAL, the results CSV and XLSX, and the data-results grid all carry the report item's value. - **Provenance:** - Flat exports name `

_selection_id`, `

_attempt_ids` and `

_batch_ids` (exportController.js:216-218, 233). - `reportedValueReadService` returns batch ids taken from the selection's own sources. - **SIS v2:** v2 stays the raw-observation contract set by #192. It already links each raw row to its saved selection through `reportedValueSelectionId`. This PR adds only nullable `attemptId` and `batchId`, declared in the capabilities, and the test checks that v2 rows, field set and counts are otherwise unchanged. This reading of "SIS v2 uses ReportedValueSelection" is disclosed in the PR description. - **Scope:** - Reports are untouched. `measuredValue` changes, but its only consumer is dataResultsController.js:79, the grid, which now heads with the measured value, while normalized values stay in `_normalized`. - There is no schema change or migration, and no analytical, QC or audit rows are written. - The new strings have keys in all five locales. - The help manifest change is a regeneration. - **PR keyword:** the issue's "Done when" asks for `Closes #213`. The PR keeps `Refs #213` under the audit-gate convention that I close the issue after the post-deploy check, and Pip has been told why. Any push after this verdict needs a new audit. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
